title: 微软2007年终止FoxPro，如今有人将其复活
summary: Visual FoxPro 在 2007 年停止于版本 9，但大量基于它的 32 位业务应用至今仍在运行，因为重写一个已有 20 年历史的企业应用往往意味着失去业务。一位客户希望在未来可预见的时间内继续使用其应用，于是该项目应运而生：在全新的运行时上运行相同的语言。该项目名为 FoxScript，目标是在不改变原有 FoxPro 语言的前提下，提供现代化的运行时环境，使旧有应用能够继续运行并可能获得新的生命力。这反映了企业软件领域一个普遍现象：老旧技术栈因迁移成本高昂而长期存活，而兼容性方案则成为延续其生命的关键途径。
summary_en: Visual FoxPro stopped at version 9 in 2007, yet a surprising amount of it is still running in 32 bits because rewriting a 20-year-old business app is how you lose the business. A customer wanted to keep milking their app for the foreseeable future, so here it is: the same language on a new runtime. The project, called FoxScript, aims to provide a modern runtime for the FoxPro language without changing it, allowing legacy applications to continue running and potentially gain new life. This reflects a common phenomenon in enterprise software: old tech stacks survive due to high migration costs, and compatibility solutions become key to extending their lifespan.
